headlines.description: — Brayan Rocchio hit a walk-off homer in the ninth inning after connecting on a tying grand slam in the fourth, rallying the Cleveland Guardians to a 7-6 comeback victory over the Detroit Tigers in the first game of a split doubleheader on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brayan Rocchio's walk-off homer gives Guardians a 7-6 comeback win over Tigers

headlines.description: — Cooper Pratt drove in a season-high four runs with a bases-loaded triple and a groundout, Brice Turang had a two-run double and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Cincinnati Reds 10-7 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pratt drives in 4 runs in the Brewers' 10-7 win over the Reds

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Jared Jones pitched six strong innings, Jake Mangum had an RBI double in the second inning and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the skidding Los Angeles Angels 1-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones throws 6 strong innings, Mangum doubles in run in Pirates' 1-0 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Atlanta’s Chris Sale outdueled Cristopher Sánchez in a matchup of two of baseball’s best pitchers, and the Braves beat the Philadelphia Phillies 5-2 on Friday night to extend their lead in the NL East to five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sale outduels Sánchez, Braves beat Phillies 5-2 and extend lead to 5 games in NL East

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Mickey Gasper hit a first-inning home run, Ranger Suarez gave up five hits in seven innings, and benches cleared after a contentious eighth-inning double play as the Boston Red Sox beat the Baltimore Orioles 1-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat the Orioles 1-0 on Gasper's 1st-inning homer; benches clear in the eighth

headlines.description: — Shota Imanaga allowed three hits and one run in six innings and Pete Crow-Armstrong doubled and stole his 33rd base as the Chicago Cubs beat the Miami Marlins 6-1 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Imanaga pitches 6 sharp innings, Crow-Armstrong doubles, steals 33rd base as Cubs beat Marlins 6-1

events.name: San Francisco Giants at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Alvarez hit two of New York's five home runs Friday night, leading Nolan McLean and the Mets to a 10-6 win over the San Francisco Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits 2 homers and Mets go deep 5 times to back McLean in 10-6 win over Giants

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit a two-run homer and Erick Fedde pitched five sparkling innings, helping the Chicago White Sox beat the Minnesota Twins 4-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colson Montgomery hits a 2-run homer as the White Sox knock off the Twins 4-1

headlines.description: — Travis Bazzana singled home Brayan Rocchio in the 10th inning to give the Cleveland Guardians a 4-3 win over the Detroit Tigers and a sweep of their day-night doubleheader Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bazzana singles home winning run in 10th inning as Guardians top Tigers 4-3 to sweep doubleheader

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Jonathan Aranda and Richie Palacios homered, and the Tampa Bay Rays overcame the first grand slam of the season by Texas in a 7-6 victory Friday night, ending a 10-game road losing streak against the Rangers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aranda and Palacios homer as Rays overcome first Rangers grand slam of season in 7-6 win

headlines.description: — Yainer Diaz hit a solo home run in a three-run third inning, Cristian Javier combined with four relievers to limit Arizona to three hits and the Astros beat the Diamondbacks 3-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yainer Diaz homers in 3-run 3rd, Astros beat Diamondbacks 3-1

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Alejandro Kirk, Ernie Clement and George Springer drove in two runs apiece to lead the Toronto Blue Jays to a 9-2 win over the Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk, Clement and Springer each drive in 2 runs as Blue Jays beat Royals 9-2 to reach .500

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Iván Herrera hit a three-run homer in the ninth inning to rally the St. Louis Cardinals past the Colorado Rockies 7-6 on Friday night, tightening a crowded race for the final National League wild card.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iván Herrera's 3-run homer in the 9th inning rallies the Cardinals to a 7-6 win over the Rockies

events.name: New York Yankees at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Luis Campusano hit a two-run homer with one out in the 10th inning and the San Diego Padres beat the New York Yankees 3-2 on Friday night to move back into the third National League wild-card spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Campusano's 2-run homer in 10th lifts Padres to 3-2 win over Yankees

headlines.description: — Zack Gelof launched one of four homers by the Athletics in a five-run third inning and later hit a tiebreaking triple that sent them to a 7-6 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Athletics hit 4 home runs in 3rd inning of 7-6 victory over Mariners

events.name: Washington Nationals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Blake Snell tossed six scoreless innings, Kyle Tucker homered for the first time since Aug. 8 and the Los Angeles Dodgers held off the Washington Nationals 5-3 on Friday night in their series opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Snell throws 6 shutout innings and Tucker ends home run drought as Dodgers beat Nationals 5-3
